goal: Loaded workspace navigation displays real departments within one second
measure_method: Temporary capture click timestamp to MutationObserver verifying department heading, both departments, desktop group and management button; browser performance.now. Separate normal navigation and early cold bootstrap samples. Instrumentation removed.
limitations: Cold application startup / clicking before organization warmup finishes still takes several seconds over remote database. Normal page switching is under one second.
Not a clean-cache or universal network benchmark. No whole repository suite claim.
changes: One company-scoped aggregate SQL read replaces SDK pagination and per-team issue RPCs.
Resolve the existing plugin manifest key directly, removing client discovery request.
Prepare the authorized company organization query and department module on workspace entry.
Keep existing department content if background refresh fails, with visible retry.
deployment: Production static files overlaid retaining old assets; existing plugin worker disabled and enabled to pick up build; core service, database and tunnel not restarted.
